subject: general
question:
The pie diagram represents the export of different types of fabrics (in degree measure) from India during 2015.

Out of the total export, what is the percentage of fabric B?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7edf13ce285cbc3ba62d43ab989a03852c4bc03b244fee11777075891b94997f.png]
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Degree measure of sector / Total degree measure) × 100

**Calculation:**

We have,

⇒ Degree measure of fabric B = 45 degrees

⇒ Total degree measure = 360 degrees

⇒ Percentage of fabric B = (45 / 360) × 100

⇒ Percentage of fabric B = 12.5%

**∴ The percentage of fabric B export is 12.5%.**
